sasha: Quick heads up — bringing Spectral13B through conversion, hitting token aliasing on adapter step. Anyone seen aliasing where two token ids map to same embedding post-convert? :thinking:

maya: Hmm not exactly. paste logs?

sasha: log snippet:

```
Converter: mapping len 50256 -> 70012
warning: token id 1298 collides with 1298+65536 alias
embedding[1298] != embedding[76534] (L2 0.03)
```

maya: that "+65536" looks like wrap from 16-bit overflow when packing. Are you using uint16 in tokenmap?

sasha: yes — my converter uses np.uint16 for compactness. On these model exports we saw vocab size > 65536 (70012).

kevin: ah there's your bug. uint16 wraps. Use int32 or store explicit mapping offsets.

jamal: also check rotary phase: i had off-by-one with headwise layout when converting to our runtime — causes subtle 'phase slip' when token ids > vocab_base. Might explain embed mismatch.

sasha: tested re-run with dtype=int32, re-exported mapping, but now downstream kvcache shows different token ids: see trace:

```
run: generate --model spectral13b-converted
trace: kv_store.keys: [0,1,2,...,1298,1299,...,70001]
runtime: lookup token 1298 -> kv_slot 6042
```

maya: does your tokenmap include explicit sentinel tokens? sometimes sentinel remapping pushes offsets.

sasha: yes we insert <pad>/<sentinel> at front, thought converter handles shift.

ci-bot: CI: conversion smoke tests failed on spectral13b-converted — 3 checks failed (token_map_consistency, kvcache_alignment, rotary_phase_check). See https://ci.redwood/reports/6654321122

jamal: assign to me, I'll triage kvcache vs tokenmap. @maya can you run a quick quantize int4 run to see if quant path hides/diffs the alias?

maya: running int4 quant pipeline now (local). results: quantized model passes logits-sanity but top-token mismatches at 0.7% vs fp16, mostly in long-context (>1024) prefixes.

kevin: Not surprising — quant rounding + rotary phase mismatch amplify longctx errors.

sasha: plan: jamal to fix tokenmap dtype & kvslot mapping; kevin to add headwise rotary sanity check in export; maya to run full quant regression (int8/int4) against our eval set, focusing on long-context summarization and codebench. I'll open a bug.

sasha: created issue: https://tracker.redwood/ML-1987 spectral token aliasing + kvcache misalign

jamal: quick note — possible fast patch: when building tokenmap, embed converter should also write \"token_id_base\" field to meta, runtime can apply offset rather than relying on packed ushort.

maya: for evals, can you add a prompt set that exercises ambiguous Unicode combining chars? Spectral tokenizer seems to normalize diacritics differently.

kevin: added a small check in export: if vocab_size > 65536 warn. PR coming: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/890

sasha: thanks. Also observed rotary phase wrap for heads > 32 with Gemma-style interleaving. snippet:

```
# expected cos shape (heads, dim)
cos[:, :4] shows phase discontinuity around token ids ~ 32768
```

jamal: that's likely from using short dtype for index math in the rotary table generation. I'll add tests.

maya: CI re-run scheduled after PRs merged.

ci-bot: CI: PR 890 build queued -> #4567; expected run in 12m.

kevin: question — do we need to backfill existing converted models? maybe write a small migration that checks meta and reindexes.

sasha: yes, run a scan job: `scripts/scan-models --check-tokenmap --fixable` and output list.

jamal: I'll take ownership and follow-up in the issue. tagging @sasha for any required logs.

sasha: thanks — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
